title: Stand before the Source that belongs to all
summary: The pauree breaks private ownership of worth. All are Yours, You belong to all, and everyone begs from the same treasure. Belonging becomes generous when the heart remembers it is received, not possessed.
takeaway: Let shared dependence make your place less guarded and more generous.
lifeApplication: When you feel the urge to defend your place, pray as one seeker among many before the same inexhaustible Source. Let that shared dependence loosen the grip.

source.shortMeaning: All belong to the One who belongs to all; every prayer is made from dependence on the same Source.
source.lifeApplication: When worth feels scarce, stand with everyone else before the One treasure instead of turning belonging into property.

evidence.coreClaim: The cited lines remove private ownership from belonging by placing everyone before the same sustaining Source.
evidence.turn: Possessiveness weakens when the heart remembers that all stand as receivers before the One.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel the urge to defend your place, pray as one seeker among many before the same inexhaustible Source. Let that shared dependence loosen the grip.
